mapper.select: SELECT FROM rel_production_entry WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND window_id=#{windowId} AND active_candidate=1 ORDER BY subsystem_name,delivery_unit_name
SELECT FROM rel_production_entry WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND window_id=#{windowId} AND subsystem_code=#{subsystemCode} AND item_key=#{itemKey} AND active_candidate=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM rel_production_entry WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND window_id=#{windowId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND item_key=#{itemKey}
SELECT FROM rel_production_entry WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM rel_production_entry WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE rel_production_entry SET active_candidate=0,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
UPDATE rel_production_entry SET active_candidate=1,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}

UPDATE rel_production_entry SET production_result=#{result},production_at=#{productionAt},result_reason=#{resultReason},updated_by=#{operatorId},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND row_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rel_production_entry p JOIN rel_release_application a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.id=p.application_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.production_result='SUCCEEDED' AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rel_production_entry n WHERE n.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND n.subsystem_code=p.subsystem_code AND n.item_key=p.item_key AND n.production_result='SUCCEEDED' AND (n.production_at>p.production_at OR (n.production_at=p.production_at AND (n.updated_at>p.updated_at OR (n.updated_at=p.updated_at AND n.id>p.id))))) ORDER BY p.subsystem_name,p.delivery_unit_name

SELECT FROM rel_production_entry p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.subsystem_code=#{subsystemCode} AND p.delivery_unit_code=#{deliveryCode} AND p.production_result='SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY p.production_at DESC,p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC

SELECT FROM rel_production_entry p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.subsystem_code=#{subsystemCode} AND p.item_key=#{itemKey} AND p.production_result='SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY p.production_at DESC,p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC
